tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga ye shes dri med

ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / rin chen shog skya'i skor/ dpal ldan ye shes 'khor lo can/ /kun bzang rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang*/ / rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal te/ /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bshad/ /de'ang sku gzugs zin nas rab tu gnas pa ni/ lugs ma yin na stod du sangs rgyas/ bar du chos dang dge 'dun/ smad du chos skyong dang gnod sbyin gyis gzungs bcug /zhabs ra bsdams/ ras bris la sogs pa'i rgyab tu bris la/ bgegs bskrad/ de bzhugs pa'i mdun du mchod pa bshams la/ rang nyid kun bzang yab yum du bsgom ste mchod pa dang bstod pa byas nas/ 'bru la rigs lnga'i rtsa sngags dang rten 'brel snying po bzlas te/ sta gon du byas nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed la/ swa bhā was stong pa'i ngang las/ rten de lha gang yin pa de nyid yi dam rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas bskyed la ye shes pa spyan drangs te/ mchod cing bstod nas bstim ste/ rigs lngas dbang bskur/ yi ge gsum gyis sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs te/ rab gnas kyis brtan par bzhugs pa'i tshig brjod nas/ rigs lnga'i sngags dang*/ rten 'brel snying pos me tog phul/ maṇḍal gyi mnga' dbul ba ni/ maṇḍal 'bul ba'i tshig gis dbyangs dang bcas pa dang*/ mchod pas mnga' dbul ba ni/ me tog la sogs pa phyi nang gi mchod pa dang*/ bstod pas mnga' dbul ba ni/ rigs lnga'i bstod pa dang*/ shis pas mnga' dbul ba ni/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa mang po brjod do/ /de thams cad kyang rgyas par dbyangs dang*/ rol mo'i sgras mnga' dbul cher byed rnam pa yin no/ /gtor ma btang nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab nas rab tu gnas pa'i dga' ston rgya chen po bya'o/ /de yang glegs bam rab tu gnas na/ yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas dang po pu ti dang*/ g.yon dang po padma/ 'og ma gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/

rin po che'i rgyan can/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pas bskor bar bskyed nas 'og min nas de 'dra ba'i ye shes pa bcug ste/ dbang bskur la sogs snga ma bzhin bya'o/ /khrus chu dang*/ bkod ma'i chu mig rab tu gnas na/ de nyid lha'i khrus kyi rdzing bu bzang pos brgyan par bsams la/ rten 'brel snying pos me tog 'thor zhing bkra shis brjod de/ khang pa dang skyed mos tshal la'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzhal med khang dang*/ lha'i nags tshal bstim la/ rab tu gnas te bkra shis brjod par bya'o/ /mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'i sku ni/ de nyid kyi sngags dang bskyed chog byas nas/ sbyin sreg dang nang mchod dang*/ bdud rtsis mchod pas mnyes par byas la/ rab tu gnas pa ni man ngag yin no/ /'dir mdor bsdus te gsal bar phye bas legs par bstan to/ /de ltar snying tig bka' gsang rgya che las/ rdzogs pa rang byung rgyud don rab bsdus te/ phyi rabs skal ldan rnams kyi don ched du/ /ye shes dri med bzang pos 'di bkod pas/ /'gro kun rnam dag rgyal ba'i zhing khams su/ /sgrib bral rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /de ltar don gsal yid 'ong cho ga 'di/ /o rgyan thugs sras dri med 'od zer gyis/ /ston gsum me tog 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe/ /gangs ri thod dkar mgul du legs par bkod/ /tshig don padma'i nags tshal dga' ba 'dis/ /skal ldan bung ba rab tu tshim par shog /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga ye shes dri med ces bya ba mkha' 'gro snying tig gi rnal 'byor pa padma las 'brel rtsal gyis/ ston ka'i dus me tog dang 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe sbyar ba rdzogs so// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen bka' 'bum/ (8)rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga ye shes dri med/ -PAGE 346--PAGE 345--PAGE 344-
